scope: methods-only synthetic known-truth; no McKee data, no dense GPS, no empirical scoring; frozen 3/31/3 unchanged
estimand: Within each declared clock/geometry world, retain one shared integer timestamp assignment across all consecutive records; each edge requires 1 <= dt <= G and distance <= V*dt. Return grid-Pareto-minimal (G,V), separately possible (exists a whole world) and robust feasible (every whole world has some schedule). No cross-world splicing.
comparators: independent local edge feasibility within each world

stress.generator: Python random.Random; 500 single worlds; n uniform 2..5; each window sorted sample of 1..4 distinct integers from 0..8; each edge integer distance 0..9; all 36 grid pairs
stress.oracle: Cartesian enumeration of complete timestamp assignments, exact integer inequalities; compare to forward reachable timestamp propagation
stress.pass: zero disagreement; zero monotonicity violations for increasing G/V; no false whole-world feasibility from exact engine

claims: H1 tradeoff has >=2 non-dominated pairs and coordinatewise minimum infeasible
H2 convex hull creates a false feasible pair
H3 across-world edge splicing creates false possible feasibility
H4 robust frontier may differ from possible frontier
H5 ordered impossible case stays infeasible across grid
stop: No physical speed inference, no time interpretation selection, no new empirical data or MEE endpoint; thresholds arbitrary synthetic units; finite grid not continuous certificate.
